Paul Small — “My Hermosa Beach” · Storyboard

14 beats · 4 acts · ~1:40 runtime · APPROVED by Paul Small 2026-07-22 (Sand Spa beat updated per approval note) · Prepared by AvatarAgency
How to read: each beat shows its key frame(s) in shooting order with the voiceover beneath. F1 = first frame, FEND = end frame (Kling/Seedance animates the motion between them).
